About.title: About us
About.intro: Gamma Piu is an online store of professional hairdressing supplies in Baku. Orders are taken through WhatsApp.
About.brandText: Gamma+ is an Italian brand of professional hairdressing tools. The company grew out of a small workshop making hair dryers and now makes everything for salon work: dryers, curling irons, flat irons, diffusers, clippers, brushes and accessories.
About.s3Label: m² of production space in two plants
About.v1c: Every solution is checked by testing
About.v2c: Compliance with CE and international standards
About.v3a: Design in the best Italian tradition
About.v3c: Distinctive lines that set each model apart
About.eventsText: Gamma+ takes part in shows, workshops, competitions and trade fairs in Italy and across Europe: Cosmoprof in Bologna, Top Hair in Düsseldorf, Beauty World in Dubai. The brand's ambassadors are top professionals, and stylists' feedback helps improve the tools.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: How this site handles your information. Short and in plain words.
Privacy.s1Title: What is saved in your browser
Privacy.s1Text: Your cart, favorites, comparison list and theme are saved in your browser. Product identifiers are sent to the site server to retrieve current product details, prices and availability. You can clear the saved lists in your browser settings.
Privacy.s2Text: This site is an informational product catalog. There is no online payment or customer account. The WhatsApp button prepares a request that you send yourself. Your message and any name, phone number or delivery address you provide are received by the seller through WhatsApp to discuss and fulfil the request. WhatsApp also processes information under its own privacy policy.
Privacy.s3Text: The site has no advertising or analytics trackers. The hosting and Supabase services process technical requests needed to load the catalog and protect the service. Staff sign-in uses authentication cookies and Supabase Auth. These services and WhatsApp may process data outside Azerbaijan.
Privacy.s4Text: Delivery is free. The final price, availability, delivery time, payment method and purchase conditions are agreed with the seller in WhatsApp before confirmation. Items marked “Pre-order” are not currently in stock; availability and lead time must be confirmed.
Privacy.s5Text: For questions about your information or a request to correct or delete it, contact the seller on WhatsApp or at kaziyevmurad507@gmail.com. Retention periods and the information needed to handle your request are confirmed by the seller.

Terms.title: Ordering and delivery
Terms.intro: An informational catalog. Requests and purchase conditions are discussed directly with the seller on WhatsApp.
Terms.s1Text: Choose a product and variant, add them to the cart, then open WhatsApp. The site prepares a message; you review and send it yourself. Adding products to the cart does not reserve stock or confirm a purchase.
Terms.s2Text: Prices are shown in AZN. Confirm the final total and payment method with the seller before agreeing to the purchase. The site does not collect payments or bank card details.
Terms.s3Text: Delivery is free. Delivery to your address and its timing are agreed on WhatsApp. “Pre-order” means the item is not currently in stock; ask the seller about availability and the expected delivery time.
Terms.s4Text: Ask the seller on WhatsApp about specifications, included accessories, warranty, returns or an existing purchase. Confirm the applicable conditions before purchasing. You can also write to kaziyevmurad507@gmail.com. These descriptions do not limit rights provided by applicable law.
